formula_documentation.MAPE: mean(abs(y_true - y_pred) / y_true) * 100 on subset where y_true > 0.01 t/ha (protects against zero/near-zero division)
formula_documentation.Within_10_Pct: mean(abs(y_true - y_pred) <= 0.10 * y_true) * 100 on subset where y_true > 0.01 t/ha
formula_documentation.Within_20_Pct: mean(abs(y_true - y_pred) <= 0.20 * y_true) * 100 on subset where y_true > 0.01 t/ha
formula_documentation.Within_1_tha: mean(abs(y_true - y_pred) <= 1.0) * 100 on all validation samples
